sections.h2: What Good UI/UX Actually Means for Your Product

paragraphs.text: UI (user interface) is how a product looks — layout, color, typography, buttons, and visual rhythm. UX (user experience) is how it feels to use — how effortlessly someone completes a task without getting stuck. A UI/UX design team in Kochi must master both, because a visually stunning screen that confuses users fails just as quickly as a functional screen that feels clunky and outdated. That standard shapes every screen designed at Teknoppy.

items.q: Is Teknoppy a dedicated UI/UX design company in Kochi, or a web agency that also does design?
items.a: Teknoppy operates as a full-service digital studio with dedicated UI/UX design sprints. Every interface project follows a structured design process — user research, wireframing, Figma prototyping, and usability testing. Because our developers work in the same team, our designs are engineered for seamless technical implementation.

items.q: Do I get the Figma source files?
items.a: Yes. Upon project completion and final payment, you receive 100% full access to the organized Figma source files, reusable components, style guides, and exported SVG/image assets.

items.q: How many revisions are included in a design sprint?
items.a: Each phase includes two structured revision cycles — first during low-fidelity wireframing to lock in structure, and again during high-fidelity visual styling. Additional rounds can be accommodated transparently if requirements evolve.
Yes. We verify color contrast ratios, font sizing, accessible focus states, and keyboard navigation against WCAG 2.2 AA guidelines during our UI design process.

items.q: Can you design for our in-house developers?
items.a: Yes. We provide complete developer-ready Figma handoff packages with auto-layout specs, spacing variables, component states, and interactive notes, accompanied by a dedicated walkthrough call with your engineering team.

items.q: Do you only design, or can you also build the product?
items.a: We do both. If you need end-to-end delivery, our development team builds custom applications in React, Node.js, and Python. Explore our Web Application Development and Web Design services for full-stack build details.

items.q: Do you run a UX audit on an existing product?
items.a: Yes. We evaluate your existing web application or mobile app to identify usability bottlenecks, confusing navigation, and drop-off points. See our dedicated UX Audit Services in Kochi for details.

items.q: How long does a UI/UX design project take?
items.a: Most website or mobile app sprints take 2 to 4 weeks from discovery to final handoff. Complex multi-role dashboards or SaaS platforms typically take 4 to 8 weeks.

items.q: How much does UI/UX design cost in Kochi?
items.a: UI/UX design projects generally range from ₹20,000 to ₹2,00,000 depending on screen count, user flows, and research requirements. We provide a transparent scope and fixed quote before kickoff.

items.q: Which is the best UI/UX design company in Kochi?
items.a: The best UI/UX partner demonstrates real screens and case studies, conducts user research rather than relying on guesswork, tests designs with actual users, provides complete source files, and offers transparent pricing. We encourage founders to compare our process with any studio in Kerala.

items.q: Can overseas or remote founders manage the project without visiting Kochi?
items.a: Yes. Most of our projects run smoothly via scheduled video conferences, shared interactive Figma links, and regular asynchronous milestone updates.
